The lenses appear to be made of a dark tinted or smoked material.
Internal reflectors and bulb housings are visible through the plastic.
The assemblies are resting on a concrete floor against a textured wall.
A watermark 'LINUS AUTO LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
A third headlight assembly is partially visible in photo 2, but it is not wrapped.
